tickets.title: Open New Client Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to collect account-opening requirements, prepare documentation, coordinate signatures, and confirm funding instructions for a new joint taxable account for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern. Verify the requested joint registration, investment objective, tax considerations, and Velvet Acorn Custody requirements before submitting; the account will be funded from excess cash reserve and ownership and risk profile information must be collected before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Gather account opening details
subTasks.text: Collect required joint registration type, ownership details for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern, beneficiary or authorized-party information if applicable, tax identification documentation status, risk profile, and intended funding source (excess cash reserve from Teacup Comet Bank or Velvet Acorn Bank) using firm-approved intake materials.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review application package
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms for the new joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody, advisory agreement updates, fee schedule, disclosure delivery record, and any transfer or funding paperwork. Check for missing signatures, inconsistent names, and incomplete suitability information.

subTasks.title: Coordinate signatures and submission
subTasks.text: Send the application package through the approved signature process for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern, track completion, and submit to Velvet Acorn Custody after verifying all required fields are complete.

subTasks.title: Confirm account setup and funding readiness
subTasks.text: Verify that the joint taxable account is established at Velvet Acorn Custody, document the account title and registration, confirm funding or transfer instructions from the excess cash reserve are ready, and notify the advisor that the account is available for investment review.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared.

tickets.title: Document household intentions before beneficiary updates
tickets.text: Document Nora and Caleb Thimblefern's current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms on Nora's IRA (~$186,000), Amber Teapot Systems 401(k) (~$428,000), and Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account (~$312,000), which still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or have no contingent beneficiary.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.

tickets.title: Obtain proof of marriage certificate from client
tickets.text: Obtain the marriage certificate from Nora Thimblefern through the secure portal; the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates and Nora had not yet uploaded it.
tickets.evidence: Proof of marriage remains needed by 2025-08-01 because the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates, and Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.

tickets.title: Refresh monthly cash flow worksheet for combined household
tickets.text: Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern using combined pay (Nora $146,000 at Amber Teapot Systems, Caleb $92,000 at Copper Firefly Works) and the six-month essential expenses reserve target, incorporating Caleb's student loan payment (~$18,000 remaining) and the townhouse mortgage ($382,000 balance) into one household plan.
